sources.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints: Historic Sites and Museums and each location page
sources.use: which sites the Church operates, names, categories, addresses, map coordinates

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors (Nominatim)
sources.use: coordinates where the official page has none, and Wikidata/Wikipedia links from the matched feature

fields.category: Historic site | Visitors' center | Monument | Museum (the Church's own label where it gives one)
fields.area: Group of sites on the Church pages (New York and Pennsylvania, Ohio, Missouri, Illinois, Nebraska and Iowa, Wyoming, Southwest Utah), blank for stand-alone sites
fields.coordPrecision: site (the place itself) | address | street | city: how exact lat/lng is
fields.coordSource: church (map link on the official page) | openstreetmap | manual (scripts/historic-site-overrides.json)
fields.source: Official page that lists the site

excluded: Entries the Church labels Visitor Amenity or Meetinghouse, and temples (see /data/lds-temples.json).
